brief: Sponsor Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical. List its stopped (terminated, withdrawn or suspended) trials in the snapshot with phase, status, stated reason and whether results were posted.

findings.claim: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical trial NCT02618915 is Phase Phase 1/Phase 2, overall status TERMINATED, stated why_stopped: "Sponsor decision; not due to any safety concerns related to DTX101.", category: business/strategic, results posted: true (results_first_post_date: 2018-11-14).

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.days_late, t.interventions FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.sponsor ILIKE '%Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical%' AND d.stopped ORDER BY t.primary_completion_date
